scenario.summary: Threat actors are abusing legitimate Microsoft Power BI links to bypass email filters and deliver rogue ScreenConnect RMM installers. The campaign utilizes multi-stage execution with CMD and PowerShell scripts to deploy redundant RMM instances, establishing persistence through scheduled tasks while using specialized tools to hide attacker activity.

hunt.name: Power BI Phishing to ScreenConnect RMM
hunt.description: This hunt identifies the delivery chain of a campaign where trusted Microsoft domains (app.powerbi.com) are used to host phishing lures. It finds hosts that visited known staging domains or specific Power BI dashboard views, then corroborates this activity by looking for ScreenConnect installer writes and rare ScreenConnect relay DNS traffic that deviates from standard corporate usage.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, url_hostname, url_path, url_full, user_agent, time FROM hb_http_activity WHERE (instr(',' || '{{staging_domains}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(url_hostname) || ',') > 0 OR (LOWER(url_hostname) = 'app.powerbi.com' AND LOWER(url_path) LIKE '/view%')) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Identify hosts that visited the Power BI phishing link or the subsequent redirect staging domains.
config.expected_signal: Rows showing specific hosts visiting staging domains. Silence suggests the lure was not clicked or filters blocked the traffic.

primitive_config.label: Visits to phishing staging infrastructure
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, url_hostname, url_path, url_full, user_agent, time FROM hb_http_activity WHERE (instr(',' || '{{staging_domains}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(url_hostname) || ',') > 0 OR (LOWER(url_hostname) = 'app.powerbi.com' AND LOWER(url_path) LIKE '/view%')) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
primitive_config.expected: Rows showing specific hosts visiting staging domains. Silence suggests the lure was not clicked or filters blocked the traffic.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, file_name, file_path, file_hash_sha256, time FROM hb_file_activity WHERE activity_id = 1 AND (LOWER(file_name) LIKE 'screenconnect.clientsetup%' OR file_hash_sha256 = '5956f9afb3ba610c38b2cfda88dd15be98783963769a12020c93ce05e749b3c3') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Find where ScreenConnect installers were written to disk, particularly in user downloads or temp directories.
config.expected_signal: Installer files written by browsers in writable paths. Silence means the payload was not saved to these monitored paths.

primitive_config.label: ScreenConnect installer file writes
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, file_name, file_path, file_hash_sha256, time FROM hb_file_activity WHERE activity_id = 1 AND (LOWER(file_name) LIKE 'screenconnect.clientsetup%' OR file_hash_sha256 = '5956f9afb3ba610c38b2cfda88dd15be98783963769a12020c93ce05e749b3c3') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
primitive_config.expected: Installer files written by browsers in writable paths. Silence means the payload was not saved to these monitored paths.

config.content: SELECT query_hostname, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) AS host_count, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_dns_activity WHERE LOWER(query_hostname) LIKE '%.screenconnect.com' AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY query_hostname HAVING host_count <= 3 ORDER BY host_count ASC
config.description: Stack-count ScreenConnect relay subdomains to surface rogue or unapproved tenants across the fleet.
config.expected_signal: A ScreenConnect tenant seen on very few hosts. Corporate instances usually show high prevalence.

primitive_config.label: Rare ScreenConnect relay subdomains
primitive_config.content: SELECT query_hostname, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) AS host_count, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_dns_activity WHERE LOWER(query_hostname) LIKE '%.screenconnect.com' AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY query_hostname HAVING host_count <= 3 ORDER BY host_count ASC
primitive_config.expected: A ScreenConnect tenant seen on very few hosts. Corporate instances usually show high prevalence.
